GameStop on Instagram: "Populate your island with Mii characters—and find out what happens when they all live there together!

New Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream arrives on Nintendo Switch April 16, 2026.

Pre-order now. Link in bio."
content.text: Populate your island with Mii characters—and find out what happens when they all live there together!New Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream arrives on Nintendo Switch April 16, 2026.Pre-order now. Link in bio.What ever you do, do not purchase from GameStop online. I purchased an X Box for my husband’s birthday that was supposed to be same day delivery. They took the money out of my account, then about 5 minutes later cancelled the order because “it was not in stock.” I have yet to receive a refund after over two weeks. I will never do business with a shady company like them.Didn’t the original Tomodachi life come first? Unless I’m wrong.Only on Nintendo switch 2 ?I know it’s probably a lot of fun but I can’t get past the ugly design of the charactersThis isn’t new yk, this has been around for agestomodachi life is nothing like animal crossingNot like animal crossing at all at least you can have love interests in tomodachiTomodachi life is nothing like animal crossingThat mii reminds me of beatrice from re zero lolGuys lets all stop comparing both games and live happily after 😍i am so sick of everyone comparing tomodachi life to animal crossing THEY ARE TWO SEPARATE GAMES PLEASE STOP THIS 😓😓😓 they're both good, we can respect them both as separate entities without having to bring up acnh Every Time tomodachi life is mentioned 💔Dont disrespect tomodachi life
